cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22)
project(ArchTerminal LANGUAGES C CXX)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
add_library(pty_core STATIC native/pty.cpp)
set_target_properties(pty_core PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
target_compile_options(pty_core PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror)
target_include_directories(pty_core PUBLIC native)
if(LIBARCHIVE_SOURCE)
    set(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(ENABLE_WERROR OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(ENABLE_TEST OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(ENABLE_TAR OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(ENABLE_CPIO OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(ENABLE_CAT OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(ENABLE_UNZIP OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    foreach(feature BZip2 LZMA ZSTD LZ4 OPENSSL MBEDTLS NETTLE LIBXML2 EXPAT PCREPOSIX PCRE2POSIX ACL XATTR ICONV CNG)
        string(TOUPPER "${feature}" feature_upper)
        set(ENABLE_${feature_upper} OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    endforeach()
    add_subdirectory("${LIBARCHIVE_SOURCE}" libarchive EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
    set(ARCH_ARCHIVE_TARGET archive_static)
else()
    find_package(LibArchive REQUIRED)
    set(ARCH_ARCHIVE_TARGET LibArchive::LibArchive)
endif()
if(ANDROID)
    add_library(archterminal SHARED native/jni.cpp native/extract.cpp)
    target_include_directories(archterminal PRIVATE "${LIBARCHIVE_SOURCE}/libarchive" "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/libarchive")
    target_link_libraries(archterminal PRIVATE pty_core archive_static)
    target_link_options(archterminal PRIVATE -Wl,-z,max-page-size=16384)
else()
    enable_testing()
    add_executable(pty_test tests/native/pty_test.cpp)
    target_link_libraries(pty_test PRIVATE pty_core pthread)
    add_test(NAME pty COMMAND pty_test)
    set_tests_properties(pty PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 30)
    add_executable(extract_test tests/native/extract_test.cpp native/extract.cpp)
    target_include_directories(extract_test PRIVATE native)
    if(LIBARCHIVE_SOURCE)
        target_include_directories(extract_test PRIVATE "${LIBARCHIVE_SOURCE}/libarchive" "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/libarchive")
    endif()
    target_link_libraries(extract_test PRIVATE ${ARCH_ARCHIVE_TARGET})
    add_test(NAME extract COMMAND extract_test)
    add_test(NAME extract_no_hardlinks COMMAND extract_test --deny-hardlinks)
endif()
